# Dashboard Portal

> Dashboard Portal is a curated A–Z index of Parth Soni's deployed dashboards and data tools.

Live site: https://dashboards-home-portal.pages.dev/
Source: https://github.com/parth-soni-10/dashboard-portal
Maintainer: Parth Soni — soni.soni.parth@gmail.com
Cost: free, no account, no cookies, no analytics.

## When to use this

Use this portal when you need to navigate between Parth's deployed dashboards:
- Content Tracker — media watchlist analytics
- RBI Weekly Dashboard — India forex and reserves
- UCD CSNL Module Picker — timetable builder
- Irish Visa Decision Tracker — embassy visa decisions
- Cents App — personal expense tracker

## How to call it

- `GET /` returns the HTML portal with dashboard cards (hash routes `#/…` for internal navigation)
- Each card links to the live dashboard on its own Pages or Workers host
- No JSON API; this is a navigation shell

## Pages

- [Dashboard Portal](https://dashboards-home-portal.pages.dev/) — the app shell
